requirements.expected_behavior: Engineers can find pending, submitted, returned and completed assigned tasks without exposing other projects or users.
requirements.verification_method: Server-filter/export tests and actual browser list/context checks
requirements.actual_result: Server-scoped bucket/count/CSV/AI-state regressions pass. Actual browser task list displays all five filters and keeps return context.

requirements.expected_behavior: A working task opens a compact checklist-and-photo workspace with one clear upload action.
requirements.verification_method: Desktop/mobile browser capture and real saved answer/upload requests
requirements.actual_result: Actual multipart uploads and saved answers use Django records. Desktop1440px and mobile390px screenshots show compact upload controls and optional site/matching details.

requirements.expected_behavior: Left pane exposes expandable Group / Section / Checkpoint hierarchy and preserves selection.
requirements.actual_result: Actual Group/Section expand/collapse, checkpoint selection, saved selection after refresh and mobile drawer keyboard focus passed in browser.

requirements.expected_behavior: Bulk/camera/gallery upload accepts uncategorized originals and batches safely, with progress/dedup/errors.
requirements.verification_method: Real multipart upload, byte hashes, dedup and corrupt/error cases
requirements.actual_result: Two real synthetic originals uploaded to isolated media without a category; byte/hash/dedup and interrupted-upload checks passed. Batches remain at most20 files. Upload alone queued no analysis.

requirements.expected_behavior: Checklist-required survey AI starts only after explicit complete submission; upload alone does not enqueue.
requirements.verification_method: Incomplete-upload, duplicate submission and legacy bypass regressions
requirements.actual_result: Explicit canonical submission creates one immutable revision/job after intake completion. Legacy retry and additional-critique bypasses blocked. Excluded/inspection Engineer uploads remain upload-only and require explicit existing photo-job submission; other-browser legacy completion remains a documented limit.

requirements.expected_behavior: Engineer explicitly reviews/applies proposals before a visible Send to QA review action.
requirements.actual_result: Browser accepted/corrected proposals, applied reviewed results, received focus on the visible Send to QA action, and posted the real workflow handoff. AI processing and operational submission remain distinct.

requirements.expected_behavior: Draft developers can refine broad disciplines into small activity sections, retaining field IDs/rules/history.
requirements.verification_method: Real Node state operation -> Django save/refresh and frozen-history checks
requirements.actual_result: Draft checkpoint movement exercised by actual Node state and Django save/refresh. Stable IDs, required/evidence rules and frozen existing survey answers were preserved; used/published edit guards remain.

requirements.expected_behavior: Project and role scopes, company ownership and team membership remain enforced.
requirements.verification_method: Project/task creation and cross-project/role regression tests
requirements.actual_result: Current full and focused regression suites cover project/company membership, owner isolation, task creation and wrong-role/foreign-project denial. No operational project assignments changed.

requirements.expected_behavior: Engineer -> QA -> Team Lead -> optional Client and one-step clarification/rejection remain correct.
requirements.actual_result: Actual browser completed both3-layer and4-layer routes, TL rejection back to QA, QA return to Engineer, corrected revision2, Client rejection back to TL, clarification and final Client approval. Independent database audit found no duplicate results and retained revisions.

requirements.expected_behavior: Client screens show only permitted read-only source evidence and released information.
requirements.verification_method: Client privacy tests plus actual browser read-only controls
requirements.actual_result: Seven privacy tests and fresh independent browser checks preserve both authorized source originals while hiding internal AI matching controls; original byte checks pass.

requirements.expected_behavior: One organized document covers all six roles with actual allowed/denied actions and role-specific known issues.
requirements.verification_method: Independent source/permission tests, PDF visual verification
requirements.actual_result: Independent reviewer inspected current server permission gates and legacy exceptions. One12-page PDF covers all6roles, allowed/denied actions and per-role issues, with iSurvix watermark and every page rendered.

requirements.expected_behavior: Improve existing modules only; do not add product modules, migrate operational approvals or rewrite originals.
requirements.verification_method: Diff review and before/after business data/file comparison
requirements.actual_result: No schema/model/dependency changes or new product modules. All59core tables,806media originals and12private/config files match the recovery checkpoint; SQLite integrityOK.

requirements.expected_behavior: Use the actual installed Agency profiles for implementation and independent QA.
requirements.verification_method: Three specialist sessions plus root Orchestrator; disjoint file ownership
requirements.actual_result: Used actual installed Orchestrator, UX Architect/Frontend Developer, Backend Architect, Reality Checker/API Tester profiles through3specialist sessions with distinct ownership and independent review.

requirements.expected_behavior: Desktop/mobile layouts have no outer overflow, keyboard focus and actionable loading/error states.
requirements.actual_result: Actual mobile/desktop browser checks passed; no outer overflow or unhandled JavaScript errors. Failed-save values survive changing checkpoints; unsaved/active uploads block navigation. Disabled controls legible and three mobile steps visible.

requirements.expected_behavior: Run focused regressions, final full backend suite, Django/migration/dependency/frontend checks.
requirements.actual_result: Final full run828tests passed in276.207seconds; native exit0, zero failures/errors/skips and guarded Python external attempts. Django/migration/dependency, four frontend scripts and31JavaScript syntax checks passed.
